description: This file defines an Android Activity class (NewDocumentActivity) that manages a 'document' in a document-centric application. It handles creating the activity, updating the document counter display, and removing the document from the overview.

classes.name: NewDocumentActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing a 'document' in a document-centric app, providing UI and behavior for document overview management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, retrieves the document count from intent extras, and sets up the UI view.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles intent to update the document counter display when activity is reused.

methods.name: onRemoveFromOverview
methods.description: Removes the document from the overview by finishing the activity and removing its task.

methods.name: setDocumentCounterText
methods.description: Updates the counter display with the current document count.
